}}'''Jala Bandevin''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jala Bandevin|comp}}

==Appearance and Personality==
She is around five feet tall.{{ref||comp}} Moiraine, at 5'2" (157 cm), is "nearly a hand taller".{{ref/book|0|7}} 

Despite her stature, she is imposing.{{ref/book|0|7}}

The ending of her surname suggests a [[Cairhienin]] origin.

==History==
Due to her already having gray hair at the time of the Aiel War, she likely to have been born before {{ne|780}}.

At this time, she had two [[Warders]], one was a round-faced man playing a stately melody on a flute, the other a pale-haired young man no more than twenty. It is unknown if those Warders are still alive by {{ne|998}}.

==Activities==
She is seen by [[Moiraine Damodred]] while she was an [[Accepted]], teaching her new Warder how to court dance.{{ref/book|0|7}}

She remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.

Jala was one of the Aes Sedai involved in capturing Egwene at [[Tar Valon#Southharbor|Southharbor]], along with [[Barasine]], [[Merym]], [[Berisha Terakuni]], and [[Felaana Bevaine]]. Jala and Merym galloped back to the Tower when they discovered who they have caught.{{ref/book|11|p}}
